scope: Publicly reported, individual health-care events in British Columbia, Alberta and Saskatchewan. This is a discovery protocol, not a finding register.

source_families.name: Indigenous journalism
source_families.purpose: Find community-reported accounts and follow-up reporting.

source_families.name: Regional journalism
source_families.purpose: Seek independent reporting and regional follow-up.

source_families.name: Official and oversight documents
source_families.purpose: Identify formal review, response, disposition or system action.

queries: site:aptnnews.ca Indigenous patient hospital British Columbia after:2025-01-01
British Columbia {health authority or hospital} First Nations patient review response
site:aptnnews.ca Indigenous patient hospital Alberta after:2025-01-01
site:albertahealthservices.ca Indigenous patient concerns annual report
Alberta {hospital or zone} First Nations patient investigation response
site:aptnnews.ca Indigenous patient hospital Saskatchewan after:2025-01-01
Saskatchewan {hospital or community} First Nations patient investigation response

query_templates: {province} {institution} Indigenous patient emergency department reported incident
{province} {institution} First Nations patient hospital review response
{province} Indigenous patient maternity care complaint investigation
{province} Indigenous patient ambulance security hospital public report
{province} coroner medical examiner Indigenous patient health care
{province} Indigenous patient human rights tribunal health care decision

preferred_order: named institution or facility + bounded date
official response or oversight body + named event
date_windows: past 12 months for recent incident discovery
event year through current year for follow-up
historical only when a public accountability chain is identifiable
search_strategy.stopping_rule: Stop after the named official, Indigenous-led, oversight and regional-source avenues have been checked, or when additional results are reposts, non-health material or already-reconciled events.

incident_record_model.privacy_rule: Retain only the least identifying public description needed to understand and reconcile the event. Do not copy medical detail or infer identity from anonymized reporting.

staging_policy.formal_finding: Only a decision, report or investigation may be labeled a formal finding; journalism alone is not one.
staging_policy.social_only: Keep out of public display and route only as a private lead where authorized.
staging_policy.public_display: Show location, source and evidence state; do not infer cause, intent, racism, negligence or an investigation from a report alone.

deduplication.rule: A shared wire story, repost, or URL is not independent corroboration. Records sharing an event fingerprint must be reconciled before public display.

exclusions: National sources cannot be assigned to a province without province-specific event evidence.
Academic research cannot be labeled an official investigation.
Institutional response material cannot by itself be labeled an incident record.
